top_signals.title: U.S. Rig Count Holds Steady as Oil Production Hits Fifth Straight Record
top_signals.summary: The total number of active drilling rigs for oil and gas in the United States stayed the same this week, according to new data that Baker Hughes published on Wednesday ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday. The total rig count in the US remains at 607, up 63 from this same time last year. The number of active oil rigs rose by 1 to 470 during the latest reporting period, according to the data. top_signals.title: Battlefield Power Is Running Short
top_signals.summary:
Drones, counter-drone systems, electronic warfare, and edge computing all run on power. Soldiers need more of it, in more places, farther from their supply lines than ever before. How will the Army get it to them? Alex Miller (U.S. Army), Ben Kesling (Chariot Defense), Julie Bush (Valinor Enterprises), and Joel Dillon (Booz Allen) join the show. They discuss moving power to the edge, managing the signatures it creates, and the push for common power standards across the services. They also explore how software can help commanders manage energy like ammunition, and what a well-run battalion’s approach to power might look
